CMFRI Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CMFRI Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CMFRI Young Professional-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.F.Sc/BSc in aquaculture or any other equivalent branch of biological science to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this CMFRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being done through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents like ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates are also required.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for CMFRI Young Professional-I going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Kavaratti, Lakshadweep, with the pincode 682555.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any preferred qualifications or skills for this post?
faq.answer: Experience in marine fisheries, seaweed farming, or aquaculture is desirable. Proficiency in swimming will also be given preference.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-I position at the Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute.
